blogs.title: FlashAttention‑3 Explained: Doubling Transformer Speed on Nvidia H100
blogs.description: An accessible overview of why attention is the performance bottleneck in large language models, how FlashAttention‑3 builds on its predecessors, and the headline results—up to 2× faster execution and 75% GPU utilization—made possible by new hardware features.

blogs.title: Warp‑Specialized Asynchrony: How GPUs Hide Latency for Faster Attention
blogs.description: A deep dive into GPU architecture concepts such as Tensor Cores, Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA), warp groups, and how FlashAttention‑3 splits work into producer/consumer warps to overlap data movement with computation, turning latency into hidden parallelism.

blogs.title: FP8 Is Here: Low‑Precision Attention Without Losing Accuracy
blogs.description: Explains what FP8 precision means for AI workloads, the challenges of quantizing attention matrices, and the clever tricks FlashAttention‑3 uses—block quantization plus incoherent processing—to keep numerical error low while nearly doubling throughput.

blogs.title: Pipelining GEMM and Softmax: The Ping‑Pong Scheduler Behind FlashAttention‑3
blogs.description: Describes how the traditionally serial matrix multiplication (GEMM) and softmax steps are interleaved using a two‑stage pipeline that lets non‑GEMM operations run while Tensor Cores crunch matrices, boosting effective FLOPs per second.

blogs.title: Real‑World Impact: Long‑Context Applications Powered by Faster Attention
blogs.description: Shows benchmark numbers across sequence lengths, discusses energy efficiency gains, and explores what these speedups mean for tasks like document summarization, code understanding, multi‑modal AI, and any application that needs very long contexts.

blogs.title: Getting Started with FlashAttention‑3 in PyTorch & Hugging Face
blogs.description: A practical guide walking developers through installing the open‑source library, integrating the new kernel into existing transformer models, profiling performance on H100 GPUs, and troubleshooting common pitfalls.

blogs.title: Beyond Hopper: Why Asynchrony & Low‑Precision Are Future‑Proof
blogs.description: Discusses how the techniques introduced in FlashAttention‑3 are not tied only to Nvidia’s Hopper architecture; they map onto other modern GPUs and accelerator designs, offering a roadmap for continued acceleration of attention layers as hardware evolves.
